user.title: Create Custom Entity
user.description: Pick a platform, a source entity, and (optionally) a presence helper.

device_class.title: Device class
device_class.description: Choose a device class for the selected platform (if applicable).

inherit_attrs.title: Mirror attributes
inherit_attrs.description: Pick which attributes to mirror from {source}. Leave empty to mirror none.

combine_toggle.title: Combine another entity?
combine_toggle.description: You can combine another sensor either into the state label (hyphenate) or as an extra attribute.

combine.title: Combine settings
combine.description: Choose the entity to combine. If you enable Hyphenate, its value will be appended to the label.

menu.title: Custom Entity — Options
menu.description: Edit any setting, then choose **Save & apply**.

core.title: Core settings
core.description: Change platform, name, source, and device class.

combine.title: Combine settings
combine.description: Hyphenate appends the combined value to the label. Otherwise the value is added as an attribute with your chosen name.

precision.title: Precision
precision.description: Label precision is used when Hyphenate is ON; Attribute precision is used when Hyphenate is OFF.

extras.title: Extras
extras.description: Both fields are optional. Leave blank to clear.
